description: Use this tool whenever a user asks to calculate the account owner's own lifetime Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) for 2025, 2026, or 2027 (Uniform Lifetime Table III, or Joint Table II when the sole-beneficiary spouse is more than 10 years younger), the federal and state tax cost of that RMD including Social Security taxation, the $6,000 OBBBA senior deduction phase-out and Medicare IRMAA tiers, Qualified Charitable Distribution (QCD) offsets, a surviving-spouse treat-as-own vs. inherited comparison with the Widow's Penalty tax jump, and an optional Form W-4R withholding plan (federal/state withholding on the RMD, net cash, and the IRC Sec. 6654 / Pub 505 prior-year safe-harbor gap). This tool does NOT compute inherited (non-spouse beneficiary) RMD schedules or missed-RMD excise penalties; for those, direct the user to the interactive calculator's Inherited and Missed-RMD modes at the returned interactiveCalculatorUrl.

balance.description: Prior December 31 retirement account balance in USD (Form 5498 FMV).

fedWithholdingPct.description: OPTIONAL. Federal income tax withholding percentage to elect on Form W-4R line 2 for this RMD (0-100). Nonperiodic IRA distributions default to 10% if the payee makes no election. Supplying this (or any withholding* / priorYear* field) adds a withholdingPlan block to the output.

federalTaxPaidToDate.description: OPTIONAL. Federal tax already paid for the current year in USD (paycheck/pension withholding plus Form 1040-ES estimates), not counting withholding on this RMD.

filing.description: Federal tax filing status (single, mfj, mfs, or hoh).

otherIncome.description: Estimated other ordinary taxable income in USD for the tax year, EXCLUDING this RMD and Social Security. For filing status mfj this must be the COMBINED income of both spouses (wages, pensions, interest, other IRA distributions, etc.). Used only for the tax-cliff and withholding layers; the RMD amount itself never depends on income or filing status. If uncertain, use last year's AGI minus last year's RMD.

ownerBirthYear.description: Account owner's 4-digit birth year (determines Applicable RMD Age: 70.5, 72, 73, or 75).

priorYearAgi.description: OPTIONAL. Prior-year adjusted gross income (Form 1040 line 11) in USD; determines whether the 100% or 110% prior-year safe-harbor percentage applies.

priorYearTax.description: OPTIONAL. Prior-year total federal tax (Form 1040 line 24) in USD. Unlocks the IRC Sec. 6654 / Pub 505 safe-harbor check: prepaying 100% of prior-year tax (110% if prior-year AGI exceeded $150,000; $75,000 mfs) avoids an underpayment penalty regardless of current-year income.

qcdAmount.description: Qualified Charitable Distribution (QCD) amount in USD transferred directly from IRA to charity (IRC Sec. 408(d)(8)).

spouseBirthYear.description: Spouse's 4-digit birth year. Triggers Joint Table II when the spouse is the sole primary beneficiary and more than 10 years younger; also used for the surviving-spouse comparison and (for mfj) the household age-65+ deductions.

ssBenefits.description: Annual gross Social Security benefits in USD for the household (both spouses combined for mfj); enter 0 if not yet claiming.

stateRatePct.description: State income tax rate percentage (e.g. 9.3 for California, 0 for Texas/Florida).

stateWithholdingPct.description: OPTIONAL. State income tax withholding as a percentage of the distribution. California defaults to 10% of the federal amount (1% of the distribution at 10% federal) unless the payee elects otherwise on Form DE 4P.

name: calculate_rmd_and_tax_cliffs
title: Calculate Lifetime Required Minimum Distribution (RMD), Tax Cliffs, Surviving Spouse Widow's Penalty & W-4R Withholding Plan
